title: Quotes
searchPlaceholder: Search by number, title or customer

form.validUntilHint: Left empty, the quote is valid for 15 days from the day it is issued.
form.linesInvalid: Every line needs a description and a quantity above zero.

detail.title: Title
detail.validUntilOnIssue: 15 days from the day it is issued
detail.noLines: This quote has no lines yet.
detail.lapsed: The validity of this quote has passed, so it can no longer be accepted. Revise it to make a new offer.
detail.workOrderMade: Work order {{number}} was made from this quote.
detail.readOnly: You can look at quotes; changing them is for managers.

issue.title: Issue the quote
issue.body: The quote is given to the customer and is valid from today. After this its lines can no longer be changed; if a change is needed later, make a revised copy.

accept.title: The customer accepted
accept.body: Record that the customer accepted this quote. You can ask for a deposit, as a share of the total.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the quote
withdraw.body: The quote can no longer be accepted. Use this when a revised quote takes its place or it should no longer stand.

deposit.title: Take a deposit
deposit.hint: Deposit due {{required}}, received {{paid}}. At most {{room}} more can be recorded.

convert.title: Make the work order
convert.body: A work order is made from this quote, with its lines, address and device. It is made once.

revise.title: Revise the quote
revise.body: A new draft is made with the same customer, address and lines, to change and issue. This quote stays as it is.

delete.title: Delete the draft
delete.body: The draft is deleted for good. A quote that has been issued cannot be deleted.
